comment: XDK functions XbSymbolDatabase does not identify in this build, named by reading the lifted library (docs/analysis/exceed-xbe-overview.md). Each entry: {"library", "name", "address": "0x...", "kind": "function"}. D3DDevice_ApplyStateBlock(DWORD Token), stdcall 4 bytes: reads the block (records from +0x3C) and replays it through SetTexture, SetPixelShader, SetVertexShader, SetViewport and the other public setters; called with the token CreateStateBlock returned (the title's 0x0004EC31).
